messages:
Carla (PM): NorthstarBank asked for a private deployment with model pinning + SLA + PCI-safe plugin. They want a committed delivery by EOD Q2. Can we give a firm date? cc @Mei @Suresh
Mei (Sales): They want timeline in the SOW. Revenue is $420k ARR. Need sign-off for EULA changes. Customer expects staging access 2 weeks before GA.
Suresh (Eng): Need scoping. Is model pinning \u201cpin to exact weights\u201d or \u201cpin to a model version id\u201d? Also does customer require quantized models? /cc @Nate
Nate (Eng-ML): For on-prem, quantization + 16-bit fallback needed. If they need 4-bit we need validation. KV cache persistence across restarts is non-trivial.
Alex (Solutions): From recent calls: must support per-tenant model pinning, user-level API key scoping, and an audit log export. Also want sub-second 95th percentile latency SLA for 1k qps.
Jamie (Eng-Infra): Dedicated pool + VPC + KMS are required. Capacity-wise we can reserve a 4-GPU pool. But provisioning + infra hardening + compliance testing ~ 6 weeks.
Priya (Legal): Contract updates: data processing addendum + SOC2 addendum. Legal review ~3 weeks after SOW.
Tori (CSE): Implementation plan from customer side: they will provide network access by May 5 and 2 engineers for 3 weeks for validation.
Carla (PM): Proposed proposal: MVP by 2025-06-20 (model pinning v1, staging access, basic SLA), GA by 2025-07-15 with audit logs & full latency targets. Is that acceptable? We need engineering confirmation.
Suresh (Eng): MVP 06-20 is tight. If we scope pinning v1 = pin by model-id (no binary rollback), + Dedicated pool, + docs, we can do it if legal and infra start now. Otherwise shift to 07-15.
Nate (Eng-ML): Acceptance criteria suggestion:
```
- API: POST /v1/serve with model_id param accepted
- Model pinning: immutable version id, revert allowed via admin workflow
- Latency: P95 <= 600ms at 1000 qps in internal perf test
- KV cache persistence: optional for MVP
```
Alex (Solutions): Also add "Customer test plan" entry: smoke tests, perf run, integration with their SRE.
Mei (Sales): I can negotiate staging date in SOW: staging by 06-25 but revenue recognizes on GA. Want firm GA date or opt-out clause.
Carla (PM): Risks: legal delay, infra provisioning, ML validation. Mitigations: can deliver hosted-compatible variant earlier as interim. Thoughts?
Jamie (Eng-Infra): Interim hosted variant feasible by 06-10. We can mirror their VPC config in our staging and run tests. Ops runbook needed.
Priya (Legal): If we do hosted-first, data residency concerns flagged. Customer insisted on private deployment for PCI. Hosted won't clear compliance.
Tori (CSE): Customer's priority mapping: must-have = model pinning + SLA. Nice-to-have = audit export, KV persistence.
Carla (PM): Decision checkpoint: by 2025-05-02 we need sign-off from Legal + Infra to commit to MVP 06-20. Action items:
- Suresh: confirm engineering headcount and dev tasks by 2025-04-28
- Jamie: draft infra provisioning timeline by 2025-04-25
- Priya: start contract review, give timeline by 2025-04-30
- Mei: lock SOW draft and customer acceptance dates by 2025-04-27
Suresh (Eng): I'll post a short tech plan after lunch.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to infra-staging on 2025-04-29 03:00 UTC - note: maintenance window
Alex (Solutions): +1 to the checkpoints. I'll draft acceptance test list and send to customer this week.
Mei (Sales): FYI I'll push for a partial credit if GA slips. :thumbsup: 
Carla (PM): Thanks all. We'll revisit in weekly roadmap sync on 2025-04-30. @everyone pls update the shared doc.
